A councilwoman from Kyle is preparing to urge a citywide ban on new data centers in an upcoming public meeting. She cites concerns over environmental impacts, zoning restrictions, and local infrastructure strain as primary reasons for the proposed limit. The initiative will be discussed with residents and officials at the scheduled town‑hall session.
